drive.description: Restrained road rhythm beneath smooth travel.

accelerate.description: Rear-loaded anticipation, nose lift, and settle.

brake.description: Nose dip, one short rebound, and a loaded stance while braking is held.

recover.description: Small overshoot when the driver releases a maneuver.

turn_left_a.description: Left turn with a bounded A anticipation and overshoot.

turn_left_b.description: Left turn with a bounded B anticipation and overshoot.

turn_left_c.description: Left turn with a bounded C anticipation and overshoot.

turn_left_hold.description: Small loaded-body drift through a held turn.

handbrake_left.description: Rear steps out while the chassis loads the outside tires.

turn_right_a.description: Right turn with a bounded A anticipation and overshoot.

turn_right_b.description: Right turn with a bounded B anticipation and overshoot.

turn_right_c.description: Right turn with a bounded C anticipation and overshoot.

turn_right_hold.description: Small loaded-body drift through a held turn.

handbrake_right.description: Rear steps out while the chassis loads the outside tires.

launch.description: One-frame compression, a tall release silhouette, and trailing wheels.

air_rise.description: Light stretched rise with wheels trailing underneath.

air_hang.description: A broad apex silhouette before the body tips into the fall.

air_drop.description: Trunk lifts during descent; its small flutter is held in drawn poses.

land_soft_a.description: Soft impact A: contact, two held compression poses, rebound, and trunk latch.

land_soft_b.description: Soft impact B: contact, two held compression poses, rebound, and trunk latch.

land_medium_a.description: Medium impact A: contact, two held compression poses, rebound, and trunk latch.

land_medium_b.description: Medium impact B: contact, two held compression poses, rebound, and trunk latch.

land_medium_c.description: Medium impact C: contact, two held compression poses, rebound, and trunk latch.

land_hard_a.description: Hard impact A: contact, two held compression poses, rebound, and trunk latch.

land_hard_b.description: Hard impact B: contact, two held compression poses, rebound, and trunk latch.

land_hard_c.description: Hard impact C: contact, two held compression poses, rebound, and trunk latch.

crash_a.description: Short accordion impact with a sprung trunk and a stable settled car.

crash_b.description: Short accordion impact with a sprung trunk and a stable settled car.

crash_front.description: Front wall: broad held squash, sprung trunk, one sharp rebound, then a shortened red wreck.

crash_left.description: Left wall: held sideways squash, outside suspension kicks, body snaps back and settles.

crash_right.description: Right wall: held sideways squash, outside suspension kicks, body snaps back and settles.

explode.description: Standalone explosion: pressure squeeze, booster-style flame burst, wheels pop loose, red body slaps down into a flat wreck.
